thread:
jess: heads up — AxiomWave flagged rising token costs and tail latency on their /chat endpoint. renewal in ~6 weeks. they see occasional wrong-entity answers on finance queries; CS health trending yellow. thinking: propose an int8 experiment + model hop to a smaller mixture for non-critical routes, plus routing by intent. thoughts?
ryan-ml: sounds doable. quick data check: top-10 intents are short Q/A (70%) and a smaller set of long-context summarizations (12%). cost concentrated on Q/A due to high qps.
priya-se: agree with intent routing. we can route summarization to high-precision model, Q/A to a compact quantized model. canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with metrics gating.
sam: customer feedback: "answers are faster but sometimes lose financial entity formatting" — captured in their survey. we should add an automated eval set that checks entity preservation before pushing to 25%.
ryan-ml: nailed it. propose workflow: 1) int8 quantize current production model for Q/A. 2) onboard compact variant (redwood/compact-qa-1.0) for intent tag 'faq'. 3) keep full-precision model for 'summarize' & 'code-gen'. run A/B on user-visible accuracy (entity-F1) and latency.
priya-se: routing config draft (canary):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": "intent:faq","model": "redwood/compact-qa-1.0","weight": 0.05},
    {"match": "intent:summarize","model": "redwood/ppx-3.4","weight": 0.95}
  ],
  "rollout": {"phases": ["5m","6h","48h"],"metrics_gate": "entity_f1 > 0.98"}
}
```
jess: nice. what's expected cost saving if compact-qa replaces prod for faq?
ryan-ml: ~28–34% token cost reduction for faq flows, latency 20–35% lower p95 due to smaller kernel scheduling. int8 alone adds another ~10% saving but might slightly affect entity-F1 (~0.5–1% measured on a small holdout).
sam: flagged to AxiomWave: we want their sign-off on the eval set and the fallback policy. they prefer automated rollback to full-precision for any drop >1.5% entity-F1 over 1 hour.
priya-se: implement fallback as route priority: compact -> int8 fp fallback -> full-precision. also enable prefix KV caching for repeated FAQ prefixes — config example: `cache.prefix_ttl=300s`.
ryan-ml: I'll spin up a quick eval harness. sample command: `./eval_harness --model redwood/compact-qa-1.0 --dataset axiomwave_faq.json --metric entity_f1,latency_p95`
deploy-bot: ticket created: CS-1429 "AxiomWave quant+routing canary" assigned to @ryan-ml, @priya-se, due 2026-01-15. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-1429 :rotating_light:
jess: thanks team — next steps: ryan run eval and share numbers, priya prepare route + canary script, sam sync with AxiomWave for eval-set sign-off. i'll follow up with renewal playbook note after initial canary. :thumbsup:
